title: Is all-inside with suspensory cortical button fixation a superior technique for anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction surgery? A systematic review and meta-analysis.

adjudication.design_quote: A total of nine studies (five randomized controlled trials and four comparative studies) involving 613 patients were included in the meta-analysis.
adjudication.k_quote: A total of nine studies (five randomized controlled trials and four comparative studies) involving 613 patients were included in the meta-analysis.
adjudication.reason: Mixed-design review pooling RCTs and non-randomised comparative studies together; no RCT-only pooled synthesis reported.
